## About Utsa Das

**Name:** Utsa Das  
**Title:** Founder & SEO + GEO Strategist  
**Location:** Bangladesh  
**Specialization:** SEO, GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), E-commerce Strategy  

Utsa Das is a digital strategy specialist focused on helping brands dominate both traditional search engines and AI discovery platforms. With expertise in technical SEO, generative engine optimization, and e-commerce systems, Utsa helps brands establish authority and drive measurable business results.
